decision_cruda.rationale: C512-12 is stopped for 5-8 h, so LH-04 is idle. I moved it to reserve RS-C564-02 (8.9 g/t, 278 t, 38.5 t/h). It should load about 235 t, or about 67 oz, by 17:00. The alternative RS-C512-01 (8.3 g/t) gives about 58 oz. Central stockpile is 147 of 450 t and trucks move 91 t/h, so there is room. No loans are needed because nothing is down. Radio and CMMS don't conflict.
